scope_guards: The structured capacity is retained once at 104 net dwellings.

Replacement public-house provision is mixed-use scope and not additional residential capacity.
Committee consideration of the variation is not silently converted into a final issued variation notice.
Deliverable and permissioned fields do not prove commencement or completion.
Non-public ownership category is not a named proprietor or title number.
A point with blank geometry is not an exact planning red-line or HMLR title polygon.
No score or promotion is written without final variation evidence, exact title relation and executed overlays.
